name: Touyama Sachie
source:
Occupation: Housemaid.
Room: Tsubomi Dorm, Room 302.
Characteristics: A little careless, but always cheerful, Sachie is a maid who supports everyone at the dormitory. She takes care of cooking, cleaning, laundry etc. She graduated from Saotome women's college of home economics, so she has the role of a senior student as well.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
